== Game Optimizer
choice  Game genre = Standard -> Change <game>
choice  Prevent input delay = Boost -> Change <hdmi>
toggle  VRR & G-Sync = On [on] -> Turn off <game>
toggle  AMD FreeSync Premium = Off [off] -> Turn on <game>
toggle  ALLM = On [on] -> Turn off <game>
toggle  Dark room mode = Off [off] -> Turn on <game>
choice  Black stabilizer = 10 -> Change <game>
choice  White stabilizer = 10 -> Change <game>
toggle  AI Game Sound = On [on] -> Turn off <volume>
